title: Set up project scaffolding
lead: Create the Go module `github.com/squalor-xyz/pitfight` (C26, C28), the `cmd/pit` + `internal/<pkg>` layout, the in-repo cache env `scripts/env.sh` (C34), `.gitignore`, the project AGENTS.md, and NOTICE (C32), with one smoke test, so every later slice can work test-first with one set of local checks.
boundary: **Not in this slice:** VM, assembler or arena code (only `cmd/pit` usage handling and an `internal/isa` package stub); any third-party module (C13); the WASM build (S14); the web viewer files; CI configuration (deferred, C33); writing or fetching the AGPL text (LICENSE waits for the owner's file, C32).

sections.heading: Why
sections.body: Every later slice is test-first and needs a known layout and one set of checks. AGENTS.md carries the project rules: pure VM core (C12), owner approval for every dependency (C13), no bundled existing warriors (C14), in-repo Go caches and the three checks (C34), implementer-recorded interface details (C35), determinism rules (C36) and Go fuzzing (C37). The license is decided (C32) but its verbatim text must come from the owner.

sections.heading: Files
sections.body:
- `go.mod` (new): `module github.com/squalor-xyz/pitfight`, the `go` line written by `go mod init` under go1.27.2; no `require` lines, no `go.sum`.
- `scripts/env.sh` (new): sourced from the repo root (`. scripts/env.sh`). Exports `GOCACHE=$PWD/.cache/go-build`, `GOMODCACHE=$PWD/.cache/gomod`, `GOPATH=$PWD/.cache/gopath`, `GOTMPDIR=$PWD/.cache/tmp`, `TMPDIR=$PWD/.cache/tmp`, `GOTOOLCHAIN=local`, `GOPROXY=off`, and creates those directories with `mkdir -p` (C34). POSIX sh, no bashisms.
- `cmd/pit/main.go` (new): `func main() { os.Exit(run(os.Args[1:], os.Stdout, os.Stderr)) }`; `run` prints a usage text naming the planned subcommands (`asm`, `run`, `tourney`, `view`) and returns 2 for no arguments or an unknown subcommand, 0 for `help`.
- `cmd/pit/main_test.go` (new): the smoke test.
- `internal/isa/doc.go` (new): package clause and doc comment only (`Package isa defines the pitfight instruction set.`); S05 fills it. It gives `gofmt -l cmd internal` a real target.
- `.gitignore`: `.cache/`, `build/`, `out/` are already listed; add Go entries `*.test`, `*.prof`, `*.out`, and `/pit` (a locally built binary). Do not ignore `testdata/fuzz/` (failing fuzz inputs are committed).
- `AGENTS.md` (new): stack (Go 1.27.2 stdlib only; web viewer plain JavaScript with JSDoc types, no framework, no tsc without approval), layout (`cmd/pit/`; `internal/isa`, `asm`, `vm`, `arena`, `replay`, `tourney`, `tui`; `web/`; `docs/spec/`; `bots/`), `. scripts/env.sh` before every Go command, the three checks from C34, the rules C12, C13, C14, C35, C36, C37, test conventions (Go `testing`, table-driven, `t.TempDir()` for files, fuzz targets with seed corpora), license (AGPL-3.0-or-later; LICENSE pending owner text; never edit LICENSE text), CI deferred (C33), and the worktree convention (`.worktrees/<name>`, branch per slice, no commits without the owner).
- `NOTICE` (new): `pitfight`, `Copyright (C) 2026 Squalor LLC`, and the standard AGPL "either version 3 of the License, or (at your option) any later version" notice paragraph, pointing to `LICENSE`.
- `LICENSE`: not created unless the owner has supplied the AGPL-3.0 text file; if supplied, copy it byte for byte.

sections.heading: Failing tests
Implement
sections.body:
1. Write `scripts/env.sh`, source it, check `go version` prints go1.27.2 and `go env GOPROXY GOTOOLCHAIN` prints `off` and `local`.
2. `go mod init github.com/squalor-xyz/pitfight` with the env sourced.
3. Write the smoke test, see it fail, then write `cmd/pit/main.go` until it passes.
4. Add `internal/isa/doc.go`, the `.gitignore` entries, NOTICE and AGENTS.md as listed in Files.
5. LICENSE: if the owner has supplied the AGPL-3.0 text, copy it unchanged and verify with `cmp`; otherwise leave it out and record a note on this item: "LICENSE pending owner-supplied AGPL-3.0 text (C32)". Either outcome completes the slice.
6. Any detail not fixed here or in the catalog (for example the exact usage wording) is the implementer's call, recorded per C35.

sections.heading: Check
sections.body:
- `. scripts/env.sh && go env GOCACHE GOMODCACHE GOPATH GOTMPDIR GOTOOLCHAIN GOPROXY` prints four paths under the repo's `.cache/`, then `local`, then `off`.
- `. scripts/env.sh && go test ./... && go vet ./... && test -z "$(gofmt -l cmd internal)"` passes.
- `. scripts/env.sh && go list -m all` prints only `github.com/squalor-xyz/pitfight`.
- `git status --short --ignored` shows `.cache/` as ignored and no cache files tracked.
- Every command named in AGENTS.md runs as written.
- `NOTICE` names Squalor LLC and AGPL-3.0-or-later; `LICENSE` is absent with the pending note recorded, or `cmp` against the owner's file passes.
- `git status --short` lists only the intended files.

sections.heading: Git
sections.body: Branch `slice/S02-scaffolding` in `.worktrees/S02`. One commit when the owner asks.
